kind: bug / Graph / sparse CSR / return handling
title: Graph mode CSRDiv fails when returning a CSRTensor result with dense Tensor operand
duplicate_search_queries: gh search issues '"Tuple to TupleUnfold pattern" "CSRDiv" repo:mindspore-ai/mindspore'
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 local csr_div docstring accepts x as CSRTensor and y as Tensor and lists CPU as a supported platform.

The local csr_div docstring/type annotation say the function returns a dense Tensor/non-zero values, but the non-scalar dense Tensor branch returns CSRTensor(x.indptr, x.indices, res_values, x.shape).
The same docstring tells users who expect CSRTensor output to use the / operator; that operator path also fails in Graph mode with the same CSRDiv TupleUnfold error.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: Graph mode raises before returning values.
Not a general CSR unsupported issue: CSR unary and dtype controls pass in Graph mode on CPU.
Not merely a documentation issue: both ops.csr_div(csr, dense) and csr / dense are executable in PyNative mode, while Graph mode fails in the CSRDiv return/unfold path.
The core Graph error is localized to CSRDiv result return handling: 'Tuple to TupleUnfold pattern should have TupleGetItem as user node, but got Default/CSRDiv-op0'.
